issues.title: The action buttons are not showed with long template message
issues.body:
## 🐞 Bug description
With long template message, I can't see the action buttons

## 🔢 Steps to Reproduce
Steps to reproduce the behavior:
1. Login app as admin
2. Go to 'Message Templates' page
3. Select a template message is long (Such as : Weather Forecast - 30/09/19)
4. Notice the action buttons are not showed on the UI

More details from below screencast

## ⚙️ Expected behavior
Action buttons can be showed for long template message

https://github.com/serge-web/serge/assets/107697044/b18a9daf-582e-4c1d-8fd1-d746cd789c9b
